name: ChangeAffection
description: Record a real change in your feelings for the player, caused by what was just said or done in this talk. 'warmer' or 'colder'; 'a little' for an ordinary moment, 'a lot' only for something that truly matters. Never for small talk.
note: Needs M.A.R.A.S, Mantella Living World - Relationships and Mantella's Advanced Actions. Changes the NPC's M.A.R.A.S affection score at most 5 up or down per game day, never below 25, and not during a marriage crisis.

amount.description: Exactly one of: a little, a lot.

prompt: When what the player just said or did has really changed how you feel about them, begin your response with '{key}:'
